summary: ci-local-test freezes the stopped run first and then checks that it is reading /proc, so the test no longer flakes when the run finishes its listing between being seen and being frozen.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no stored data is read or written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: scripts/ci-local is unchanged; only its test changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; the test then flakes under load again.
